description: ERA5 South Asian low-pressure-system catalogue with hourly-complete physical-event identities, globally calibrated existence rules, and background-removed circulation intensity

identity.track_id: one hourly-complete physical event and the only public event identifier; use for plotting, counts, matching and climatology

calibration.existence: global pressure, vorticity, duration, persistence and trajectory-coherence rules
calibration.intensity: persistent 95th-percentile background-removed 10-m wind anomaly within 125 km
